data.title: Wahba Crater
data.subtitle: A trip to shiny dormant volcanoes
data.description:
Wahba Crater is the largest and deepest volcanic crater in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with a diameter of 3,000 meters, and surrounded by Al Luhayan, Umm Rilan, and Zabna mountains forming a scenic view that embodies the wonders of nature in Saudi Arabia.

The Crater, which is about 380 meters deep, attracts geologists to explore its secrets and observe its diverse and exotic rock formations. Traditional legends are known and spread among residents of nearby villages around the Crater formation.

data.title: Clouds
data.subtitle: Stay at Clouds: Modern comfort and breathtaking views await
data.description: Step into Clouds, a hotel and residential retreat where modern elegance blends with Aseer tradition. Enjoy the breathtaking views at Juliette Restaurant and Café, where every meal is a feast for the senses. Unwind in our luxurious spa and experience the perfect blend of comfort and style at Clouds.

data.title: Obhur corniche
data.subtitle: Enjoy a trip to the stunning Obhur Corniche!
data.description: Obhur Corniche is one of Jeddah's premier waterfront destinations, perfect for strolling and spending quality time with family and friends. Enjoy the breathtaking views of the Red Sea while taking advantage of its diverse recreational facilities, making it an ideal spot for everyone.

data.title: Liwan Farm
data.subtitle: Experience Rural Charm at Liwan Farm
data.description: Liwan Farm offers a unique rural retreat where visitors can experience the charm and simplicity of farm life. Nestled amidst beautiful landscapes, the farm provides a serene environment perfect for families and nature lovers looking to escape the hustle and bustle of city life and reconnect with nature. Enjoy a stay at the authentic inn and explore a variety of cafes and restaurants catering to all tastes. The farm also reflects Aseer’s rich history, showcased in a museum with unique and rare artifacts.

data.title: Diriyah Flagpole
data.subtitle: Discover the tallest flagpole in Riyadh
data.description: From the heart of Diriyah, with its rich history that accompanied the stages of founding and unifying the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the Saudi flag rises on the flagpole of King Salman Square. This flagpole is considered the tallest flagpole in the capital city of Riyadh.

data.title: Wadi Safar Dam
data.subtitle: Outdoor Seatings
data.description: In the western side of Diriyah, Wadi Safar Dam is located on a 60-square meter area. It is an extension of Wadi Hanifa. The location is characterized by its rural nature, and contains rock seating areas with wonderful views and a nice ambience, giving you the opportunity for a special picnic with family and friends in the weekend, surrounded by warm cups of tea, along with the aromas of barbecues.

data.title: Wadi Namar
data.subtitle: A natural painting awaits you
data.description: Wadi Namar enables you to watch the roaming of ducks’ flocks and the spread of small fish in the Lake Dam. Inspirational thoughts will flow to your mind as you walk along the park’s paths that extend over 2,000m, amidst the fresh air of nature, the rustle of palm trees, and the roar of the lake’s waterfalls. The nature of the place integrates, allowing you to take pictures of the sunset or admire the starry sky at night, in a scene in which the reflected lights of the valley shine around.

data.title: Heet Cave
data.subtitle: Your trip to a cave that dates back thousands of years
data.description: At a 30-km distance in the outskirts of Riyadh, on the South of the road leading to Al-Kharj, lies Heet Cave, a geological landmark about which many interesting stories have been told. You are promised to see one of the most beautiful natural landmarks, which dates back to thousands of years. Many exciting stories have been told about it, most notably that it was formed as a rocky cavity with a depth of 390 m inside a mountain after a celestial body struck the Earth.

data.title: Habu View
data.description: Enjoy the charming sunset with a view of the surrounding countryside, forests, mountains, and fog.

data.title: The Vineyard
data.subtitle: A Taste of Aseer: Savor the Freshness of Local Fruits
data.description:
Discover the charm of The Vineyard, a picturesque farm where you can wander through lush fields brimming with a variety of local fruits. Located in the heart of Aseer, this farm offers a delightful escape into nature, featuring figs, grapes, pomegranates, and peaches.

Enjoy a leisurely stroll through the orchards, where the vibrant colors and fresh scents of the fruits create an enchanting atmosphere. The Vineyard also provides comfortable seating areas where you can relax and savor delicious meals and refreshing drinks surrounded by stunning natural beauty. This serene retreat is perfect for a day out with friends or a romantic getaway with your partner, offering a unique blend of relaxation and culinary delight.

data.title: Honey Cottage
data.subtitle: Savor the Sweetness of Nature in Rijal Almaa
data.description:
"Nestled in the picturesque village of Rijal Almaa, Honey Cottage offers an enchanting escape into the heart of nature. This rustic retreat, crowned with a charming windmill, provides not only stunning views of the surrounding landscape but also a delightful array of locally produced honey, making it a honey lover's paradise.

At Honey Cottage, you can immerse yourself in the serene beauty of the Aseer region. The cottage is designed in a traditional wooden style, surrounded by lush greenery and natural valleys. Here, you can taste over 40 different types of honey, each with its unique flavor profile, harvested from the local flora. Whether you're enjoying a peaceful moment on the cottage porch or exploring the scenic trails nearby, Honey Cottage offers an exceptional experience that blends relaxation with a touch of local heritage. Perfect for friends seeking a sweet retreat, this destination promises memorable moments and a taste of the rich, natural bounty of Rijal Almaa."

data.title: Wadi Al Fann
data.description: Translating to “Valley of the Arts,” this new cultural destination is a blank canvas for large-scale art. Take a walking tour through the valley to see some unique, dramatic, and impressive works of contemporary art.

data.title: Al Habala Park
data.subtitle: Where Sky Meets Earth in a Majestic Panorama
data.description:
Immerse yourself in the breathtaking natural beauty of Al Habala Park, a stunning attraction in the Aseer region that promises an unforgettable experience for all visitors. Located at a high altitude, this park offers panoramic views where the sky seamlessly merges with the earth, creating a serene and picturesque setting.

At Al Habala Park, you can enjoy a variety of activities that cater to all family members. Take a thrilling ride on the cable car, which provides spectacular aerial views of the surrounding landscape. Explore the park's lush greenery and discover hidden waterfalls that add to the enchanting ambiance. For those who love adventure, there are ample opportunities for camping under the stars, allowing you to connect with nature in a profound way. Children will delight in the dedicated play areas, while a selection of restaurants and cafes ensures that you have plenty of options to relax and enjoy delicious meals. Whether you're seeking tranquility or an action-packed day out, Al Habala Park offers a perfect blend of natural beauty and recreational activities, making it a top destination for families.

data.title: Alsamaa Eaqabat View
data.subtitle: Unveil the Majestic Panoramas of Rijal Almaa
data.description:
"Experience the awe-inspiring beauty of Alsamaa Eaqabat View, a breathtaking vantage point in the Aseer region that offers unparalleled views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. This scenic spot, a vital link between the peaks of Al Soudah and the villages of Al Sharaf and Rabia, leads you down to the historic province of Rijal Almaa.

At Alsamaa Eaqabat View, you can immerse yourself in the stunning landscape that unfolds before you. The panoramic vistas are particularly captivating at sunset, when the sky is painted with hues of orange and pink. The viewpoint is equipped with lighting to enhance your visit after dark, providing a magical nighttime experience. Families will appreciate the dedicated children's play area, making it a perfect outing for visitors of all ages. Whether you’re a nature lover, a photography enthusiast, or simply seeking tranquility, Alsamaa Eaqabat View offers a serene escape with unforgettable scenery."

data.title: Cypress Cottage
data.subtitle: Experience Rustic Elegance in the Heart of Tabab Heights
data.description:
"Nestled within the lush expanse of Tabab Heights, Cypress Cottage offers a unique blend of modern comfort and rural charm. This thoughtfully designed retreat, inspired by European countryside lodges, provides an unforgettable stay amidst more than a hundred towering cypress trees, making it an ideal escape for nature enthusiasts.

At Cypress Cottage, you'll find yourself surrounded by breathtaking greenery and refreshingly cool temperatures, a hallmark of the Tabab region. The cottage itself boasts contemporary furniture crafted from ancient trees, some over a thousand years old, seamlessly blending rustic aesthetics with modern amenities. This serene haven invites you to unwind and rejuvenate, whether you're enjoying a peaceful morning coffee on the porch or exploring the scenic surroundings. Perfect for couples seeking a romantic getaway, Cypress Cottage promises a tranquil and picturesque retreat in the stunning Aseer region."

data.title: Mountain Cottage
data.subtitle: Escape to the Majestic Peaks of Aseer
data.description:
"Perched atop the highest peaks of Manaa, Mountain Cottage offers a unique retreat for those seeking tranquility and breathtaking views. This rustic haven, situated in the heart of Tanomah, immerses you in the serene beauty of mountain life, far from the hustle and bustle of daily life.

Mountain Cottage is designed with an innovative blend of recycled materials, including aged wood and dried trees, creating a cozy and sustainable interior. Relax in the fresh mountain air and let the soothing sounds of nature transport you to a world of peace and serenity. The cottage features a charming outdoor garden surrounded by wheat fields and majestic mountains, providing an idyllic setting for relaxation and reflection. Enjoy a peaceful night's sleep in a bed crafted from reclaimed wood, and start your day with a coffee in the cozy nook. Open year-round, this enchanting spot is perfect for couples looking to reconnect with nature and each other."

data.title: Al Fairouz Park
data.subtitle: A Day in Nature’s Embrace
data.description: Enjoy a relaxing picnic among the rustle of trees and the fragrances of flowers in Al Fairouz Park.

data.title: Yanbu Lake Park
data.subtitle: Enjoy the beauty of nature and birds
data.description: On your visit to Yanbu, you must go to Yanbu Man-Made Lake (Yanbu Lake Park). It is one of the most beautiful public places in Yanbu, where you can enjoy picturesque nature and take a walk in the open air.

data.title: Al Sumayri Public Park
data.subtitle: One of the must-visit parks in Yanbu
data.description: If you want to go for a walk in the fresh air, meditation nd relaxation, or if you want to have fun with your children, Al Sumayri Public Park is your destination.

data.title: King Khalid Park
data.subtitle: The pleasure of nature
data.description: King Khalid Park in Buraidah is a destination for relaxation. Its lush green spaces and shady trees are in a vast area designed to accommodate family and friend gatherings. It offers a joyful outdoor atmosphere and the beauty of nature.

data.title: King Fahad Park in Najran
data.subtitle: One of the most beautiful outings in Najran
data.description: King Fahd Park is located in the Saqam Forest and is one of the most important natural recreational landmarks in the city and its largest park. The park is characterized by its stunning natural scenery and breathtaking views, and it offers a range of enjoyable activities suitable for all family members.

data.title: Juman Park
data.subtitle: A destination for relaxation and entertainment
data.description:
A peaceful and entertaining atmosphere awaits you at Juman Park, located in King Abdullah Economic City, adjacent to the canal Bay La Sun district, specifically between Bay La Sun Hotel and Marina.

The park has a total area of about 55,000 square meters and features beautifully designed green spaces overlooking the stunning blue canal.

It provides a refreshing and joyful experience for your soul and includes facilities and activities that will create lasting memories for you and your family.

data.title: Gharameel Stargazing
data.subtitle: Stargazing Unlike Anywhere Else
data.description: Embark on an exciting celestial adventure far out in the desert on a stargazing trip to Gharameel. Hear from an expert guide as you admire the blanket of stars overhead while surrounded by photogenic pillars of mountain rock that reach skywards.

data.title: Elephant Rock
data.subtitle: Icon of AlUla
data.description: Get up close to AlUla's beloved Elephant Rock, a special landmark and must-see spot. This natural marvel, shaped by millions of years of erosion, rises 52 meters high. Enjoy its magical presence at dusk, bathed in warm crimson light, while warming up by a fire pit nearby.

data.title: Dareen Hills Park
data.subtitle: Large park on the beach
data.description: Dareen Hills Park in Al Jubail is characterized by its pleasant atmosphere, refreshing breeze, and stunning nature, covered with vast green spaces overlooking the seaside, making it an ideal daily destination.

data.title: Al Hamra Park
data.subtitle: Family outings
data.description: Al Hamra Park in Al Jubail is a recreational area for the residents of the neighborhood, covering an area of 75,000 square meters. It includes chairs distributed throughout its extent, a pedestrian path, a bicycle path, as well as a football field and a play area for children, allowing the whole family to enjoy special times amidst greenery and fresh air.

data.title: Al Nakheel Beach
data.subtitle: Recreational and hiking destination
data.description: With its view of the Arabian Gulf coast, Al Nakheel Corniche in Al Jubail is a wonderful tourist destination for beach lovers and walking on the sand, where you can face the successive waves of the sea and enjoy quiet moments in its seating areas designed in the form of a traditional "arish" structure.

data.title: Al Asfar Lake
data.subtitle: Discover the purity of nature in Al-Ahsa
data.description: Al Asfar Lake appears amidst the golden dunes and in a charming scene, which was formed by seasonal rain over decades and is locally called (the summer blue and the winter white) because its color changes according to seasons. It is one of the largest natural water bodies in the Gulf region and has been transformed into a nature reserve to encompass the surrounding wildlife, as desert plants surround the lake, trees converge around it and cover the horizon, the soft and pure sands remain.

data.title: Largest Palm Oasis in the World
data.subtitle: A look at the captivating natural museum
data.description: The natural oasis of Al-Ahsa, whose area exceeds 85 square kilometers, reveals geographical artifacts that are full of details of its unique terrain and the diversity of its environment, including caves, mountains, plains, and springs, to be deservedly included in the UNESCO World Heritage List since 2018.

data.title: Art Street
data.subtitle: See street art on Art Street
data.description: In an astonishing experience, Art Street takes you on a trip full of colors and creativity to another dimension in the arts space, to taste the works of artists and creators of the region. Immerse yourself in an exceptional journey out of the ordinary and prepare to discover one of the most beautiful art streets in the world.

data.title: Rose Product Factories
data.subtitle: Trips to explore products made from roses
data.description: You must return from your trip to Taif loaded with the fragrance of roses, whether with the pictures you took to enjoy their beauty or by buying their distinguished products. One of the most beautiful exceptional experiences that you will have is a visit to the famous factories of Taif rose products to embark on a rich and unparalleled journey of exploration.

data.title: Arruddaf Park
data.subtitle: Fun Beyond All Boundaries
data.description: Enjoy Taif’s rocky terrain and its pure fresh air in Arruddaf Park. The park spans over 500m2 of land covered in nature's most vibrant colors. You can bask in the beauty of the cirrus clouds as they float over the marvelous greenery and highlands of the park. You can also enjoy the beautiful sounds of nature or the live musical shows accompanied by interactive water fountains.

data.title: Al-Hada Mountain
data.subtitle: Darb Al-Jammalah Whereabouts and More
data.description: It is time to discover the majestic Al-Hada Mountain, one of the most famous mountains in Saudi Arabia. Al-Hada Mountain is one of Al-Sarawat Mountains range extending in a curved line of about 87 km between the two cities of Taif and Makkah. You will certainly notice the gradual drop in temperature on your journey on Al-Hada Road.

data.title: Al-Shafa Mountain
data.subtitle: Where Mountains Embrace the Sky
data.description:
At the top of Al-Shafa Mountain over 2500 m. above sea level, you will enjoy the natural stunning scenery of the white fog embracing the tall Sarawat Mountain peaks with its emitting aroma of juniper trees. You can take beautiful shots of the warm sun setting down the mountains overlooking the Tohama plains, the fertile valleys, and the green fields of pomegranate, grape, and fig trees.

The distance between Al-Shafa Mountains and Al-Taif is about 30 km by car through Okba Al-Mohammadia Road which connects Al-Taif to Makkah.

data.title: Prince Fahad Bin Sultan Park
data.subtitle: In the arms of nature
data.description: On a sunny day or a cold night in Tabuk, you can lay on the green grass that stretches over an area of 500,000 square meters in Prince Fahad Bin Sultan Park, families and friends gather while enjoying a cup of Saudi coffee flavoured with saffron and cardamom, surrounded by lush trees and fresh air.

data.title: Al Murooj Park
data.subtitle: Fun times in green spaces
data.description: The nature in Tabuk City is diverse and includes many green spaces, including gardens equipped with all services, numbering about 44 gardens, including Al Murooj Park.

data.title: Sofie Farm
data.subtitle: One of the best rural experiences in Diriyah
data.description: In the calmness of nature away from the crowded city, you will find Sofie Farm, one of the best rural experiences that is available all week long, from 7:00 am to 7:00 pm.

data.title: Samhan Farm
data.subtitle: Explore the wonderful rural nature close from the city
data.description: Samhan Farm is 230 Kilometers away from Wadi Hanifah; it combines between the ancient past and modern present, it has beautiful green areas and lots of trees.

data.title: Ghubaira Dam
data.subtitle: Learn about the dam that was built 50 years ago
data.description: With a storage capacity of 900 thousand m3 and a length of 170 meters, learn about the 50-year old Ghubaira Dam, one of the side dams of Wadi Hanifa in the new Diriyah.

data.title: Wadi Hanifa
data.subtitle: Talks under the starry skies in the middle of nature
data.description:
With a length of 120 km, Wadi Hanifa extends from the heights of Al-Haisiyah in the North to Al-Hayer in Southern Riyadh. Within this vast area, you can make dozens of plans to enjoy the beauty of nature. Recreation facilities are available on both sides of the 57-km-long Wadi Hanifa water channel. You are going to enjoy this trip to its fullest!

Wadi Hanifa is uniquely redeveloped. Its banks are adorned with parks with complete facilities and services to allow visitors to enjoy the green landscapes in a joyful atmosphere in the open air.

data.title: Al-Bujairi Heritage Tourist Park
data.subtitle: A Lush Oasis Is Waiting For You
data.description: Al-Bujairi Heritage and Tourism Park is a lush oasis surrounded by palm trees, which includes great green landscapes, and natural landmarks such as plants, lakes, and heights, enabling you to enjoy moments of peace and tranquillity.

data.title: Fakieh Aquarium
data.subtitle: Marine marvels
data.description:
Located just off Al Kurnaysh Road on Jeddah’s north corniche, Fakieh Aquarium is the first marine exhibition of its kind in Saudi Arabia, and it’s no coincidence that it finds itself within earshot of the city’s lapping Red Sea.

The sprawling tunnels and vast tanks that make up the aquarium house over 200 species and around 85 percent of them are native to Jeddah’s undisturbed coral reefs. It makes this colorful window onto the Red Sea the best way to experience the region’s vibrant underwater ecosystem without needing to squeeze into scuba gear.

Accompanied by a meditative soundtrack and enclosed in cavern walls, a trip through the aquarium brings you face-to-face with some of the 800 Red Sea oddities that don’t exist anywhere else on the planet.

Throughout the tour, detailed information is provided in both English and Arabic. It means visitors can find out how the Red Sea got its name (hint: it has to do with blooms of algae), and learn about fish like the Napoleon wrasse, which are all born female before some transform into males on maturity. There’s also the territorial sohal surgeonfish, endemic to the Red Sea and named for its scalpel-sharp fin.

For more peculiarities, seek out the upside-down jellyfish known as the Cassiopeia, or the thin, long garden eels with their playful tendency to bob up and down in the sand as visitors approach.

Less amusing is the fish you’ll be relieved to see in a tank rather than in the open sea; a stern-looking stonefish deemed the most venomous fish in the world, possessing enough venom to kill a fully-grown man in under five minutes.

The knowledgeable staff is also proud to inform visitors that some endangered marine life – including giant turtles – have been rescued following injury or illness. Those that are able to recover fully are then released back into their natural habitat.

data.title: Jeddah Waterfront
data.subtitle: Sun, sea and sports at the city’s newly developed coastline
data.description: This is no doubt the place everybody adores, a place that instantly and seamlessly delights and revitalizes your heart. It is precisely where visitors fall deeply captive in Jeddah. Strap on your shoes and come explore one of the latest waterfronts in the world.

data.title: King Fahd’s Fountain
data.subtitle: Show time
data.description: Visible from all across the city, King Fahd Fountain is a much-loved Jeddah landmark and a 30-year-old monument in the middle of the Red Sea. At 312 meters high, its waters decorate the sunset of Jeddah, and whether you are thinking of taking a picture or a video of that magical scene, seeing the fountain will not seem impossible no matter how far away you are. As the spectacular display of the fountain continues, you can walk around and try different kinds of food along the various stalls in Alhamra Cornish. Seven is the most popular kiosk on the walkway.

data.title: Edge of the World
data.subtitle: Discover Edge of the World Cliff in Riyadh
data.description: Edge of the World is the name of the 1.131 m height cliff that lies some 100 km from Riyadh at the end of the 800 km extending Tuwaik Mountain range. Edge of the World is the perfect destination of mountain climbing and hiking lovers. Discover the breathtaking off-cliff spectacular views.

data.title: Rawdat Tinhat
data.subtitle: A Walk Among Tulips
data.description: In the range of King Abdulaziz National Reserve, you will find the biggest natural meadow in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with an area of ​​​​140,000 km² and extended greenery within sight. Discover the wonderful days you will spend in Rawdat Tinhat.

data.title: Al Kharrarah National Park
data.subtitle: Your natural sanctuary
data.description: Al Kharrarah National Park, located in the South of Al Muzahimiyah Governorate, West of Riyadh, is your spacious sanctuary to escape from the crowded city. You can relax and sit amid nature, which is full of green landscapes, sand dunes, and a lake formed from rainfall. Wild Sidr trees and annual plants also grow in the park. You will enjoy a serenity-filled family time.

data.title: Nature Charm at Fifa Mountains
data.subtitle: Green Nature in Saudi Arabia
data.description:
The Fifa Mountains, or as they are called "Neighbor of the Moon", are distinguished by their enchanting view, at an altitude of more than 1,800 km above sea level. They are a series of mountains wrapped around one another, with peaks covered with green, including: Al-Lagha, Al-Kadrah, Baqat Al-Washl, Al-Surrah, Qardah, and Al-Sama'. The highest one is Al-Absiyya summit.

The Fifa Mountains are about 100 km from the city of Jazan, and the climate there is moderately characterized most of the year. In winter, it tends to be cold in the high mountains, with a temperature of approximately 19-29 degrees Celsius.

data.title: Raghadan Forest
data.subtitle: Nature, adventure, and family fun await at Raghadan Forest Park!
data.description: Raghadan Forest Park in Al Baha stands out as one of the largest and most celebrated forests in Saudi, covering an extensive area often shrouded in fog. Perched at a high elevation, it is home to trees that have stood for centuries. Raghadan Forest Park is a hub of activities, events, and facilities for all ages, featuring stunning views of Al Baha's natural scenery, foggy peaks, waterfalls, a suspension bridge elevated 13 to 15 meters, and exciting zipline adventures. The park also includes a children's play area, shopping, and dining options, providing visitors with an opportunity to immerse themselves in nature and various exciting activities.

data.title: Al-Zaytouna Farm in Al-Baha
data.subtitle: Walk in the Magic of Nature
data.description: Al-Zaytouna Farm in Al-Baha spans an area of approximately 150,000 square meters, with one hundred agricultural terraces extending along the Sarawat Mountains, specifically in Bahar Center on the Al-Aqiq road. The farm includes more than 4,000 olive trees, in addition to three tanks for storing rainwater, a bird breeding garden, and a horse stud, making it a stunning destination for tourists all year round, offering a charming experience in picking agricultural crops, enjoying scenic views, and savoring delicious dishes prepared on-site by skilled chefs.
